proposal.summary: The report describes an improper certificate validation vulnerability (CWE-295) in multiple Fortinet products and versions that may allow a network-adjacent, unauthenticated attacker to man-in-the-middle communications between the listed products and some external peers.
proposal.affected_product: FortiManager 7.0.1 and below, 6.4.6 and below; FortiAnalyzer 7.0.2 and below, 6.4.7 and below; FortiOS 6.2.x and 6.0.x; FortiSandbox 4.0.x, 3.2.x and 3.1.x

AV.quote: may allow a network adjacent and unauthenticated attacker to man-in-the-middle the communication between the listed products and some external peers.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request technical details or vendor advisory showing the certificate validation flaw, affected code paths, and whether confidentiality, integrity, or availability of data is impacted; obtain repro or PoC to confirm impacts.
